name: A finished Brotherhood of Thieves stops offering Red Burlap Bandanas on corpses killed earlier
contract: Brotherhood of Thieves (quest 18) asks for 8 Red Burlap Bandanas (752); Defias Thug (38) drops one only for players who need it (creature_loot_template QuestRequired 1). A player holding 7 kills two Thugs before looting, so both corpses are assigned a bandana. The first corpse offers it and looting it completes the quest. The second corpse, opened after the quest is complete, must not offer a bandana the player can no longer take: before #9023 it was listed as a locked slot and clicking it closed the loot window.

steps.label: Take Brotherhood of Thieves; the fixture hands over all 8 bandanas
The quest still needs a bandana
A corpse offers the bandana while the quest needs it
The eighth bandana completes the quest
